tools/engines/merge_script_generator.py|.reason: The second read is a Latin-1 decoding fallback attempted only after the UTF-8 acquisition fails. Keeping separate reads preserves fault isolation.

tools/engines/quant_engine.py|run_quant_.reason: Direct-scope and broad-scope branches are mutually exclusive evidence universes: one reads the scoped watchdog Audit and the other reads canonical broad Audit, so only one acquisition occurs per invocation.
